verdict.rationale: Codegen publishes its own API reference with per-endpoint pages (list agent runs, resume agent run, agent run logs, integrations, sandbox log analysis, PR edits) and SDK docs with a code example. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable examples within the API reference, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories with full programmatic control over their execution and monitoring.
The Agent Run Logs API allows you to retrieve detailed execution logs for agent runs, providing insights into the agent's thought process, tool usage, and execution flow.
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
task = agent.run(prompt="Leave a review on PR #123")
